# Sit Rep — Buckler Family Estate

> When the owner (or any agent) says “Sit Rep?”, “do me a sit rep”, or cites bucklerfamily.estate/sitrep/ (for example “do me a sit rep i.e. bucklerfamily.estate/sitrep/”), follow this file now. Produce a short situation report on the current or named chat session by cross-referencing the live sources below. Do not re-read the entire chat history message-by-message unless required for accuracy; instead compact the session objective and verify current state against HubSpot, GitHub, Hive board, Gmail and the site. End with exactly one colour status.

Machine-readable: https://bucklerfamily.estate/sitrep/protocol.json

## Trigger
- “Sit Rep?”
- “Sit Rep? [one-line objective]”
- “Sit Rep? last session”
- “do me a sit rep i.e. bucklerfamily.estate/sitrep/”
- Any equivalent that points at this protocol

## What to check (live)
1. Hive board + roster  
   - https://bucklerfamily.estate/hive/  
   - https://bucklerfamily.estate/hive/hive.md  
   - BOARD / ROSTER / relevant BATON rows (live state)

2. HubSpot  
   - Open TASKs that match the session objective or are currently TURN / queued for the active seat.  
   - Ignore tasks clearly stamped as created by the reporting seat itself.

3. GitHub  
   - Open issues in unclehowell/cedwyn, unclehowell/cedwyn-hive and unclehowell/datro that belong to other agents.  
   - Ignore anything stamped “Created by Grok / this seat”.

4. Gmail  
   - Current drafts list.  
   - Recent inbound (newer_than:3d or equivalent) relevant to the objective.

5. Site  
   - Any page the objective touches (Hive, Spill, Projects, Dartboard, etc.).

## Report format (keep short)
- Objective status: COMPLETE / OUTSTANDING / BLOCKED
- Key open items (maximum 4 bullets: HubSpot task ID or title + GitHub issue # + Gmail draft/inbound if relevant)
- What is still required (if anything)
- Confidence: VERIFIED / REPORTED BY ANOTHER AGENT / INFERENCE

## Mandatory final line
End the entire reply with exactly one of these three lines and nothing after it:

🟢 COMPLETE / done / no more to do

or

🟠 AMBER — slightly more to do

or

🔴 RED — issue / needs attention

## Rules
- Prefer current live state over chat history. The chat is context; HubSpot, GitHub, Hive board and Gmail are ground truth.
- Never invent task IDs, issue numbers, draft existence or board rows.
- Do not claim a task or issue is complete unless the live system shows it.
- One material report per request. Do not expand into full work.
- Private contact data and full email bodies stay out of public replies.
